_readme: The About modal, opened from the About nav link and #about. Same section format as content/projects/*.json; the 'team' section type lists each person.
title: About JACkaL

sections.title: About JACkaL
sections.summary: We’re four Information Management graduate students covering user research, data and business intelligence, product design and front-end development, so your project goes from first interviews to a measurable prototype with one team.

pillars.title: User research
pillars.text: Interviews, media elicitation, journey mapping and qualitative analysis.

pillars.title: Data & business intelligence
pillars.text: SQL, R, Python, GA4 and Tableau to measure what matters.

pillars.title: Product design
pillars.text: 0–1 product design, design systems and accessible web design in Figma.

pillars.title: Front-end development
pillars.text: Rapid prototypes and MVPs, built and shipped in code.

members.name: Jaime
members.bio: Jaime brings user research and data analysis to the team, from geospatial analysis in ArcGIS to statistical work in R and Python, and turns findings into prototypes in Figma.

links.label: Case study
links.text: [Musician Booking](#musician-booking): Lead User Researcher on a qualitative study of how early-career musicians in Seattle make themselves “bookable,” using media elicitation and journey mapping with four musicians.

members.name: Athan
members.bio: Athan keeps projects on track and grounded in data, combining project management with business intelligence in SQL, operations and automation, and research methods.

links.label: Case study
links.text: [APS & Transit](#aps-transit): Project Manager on an evaluation of 42 signalized intersections in Seattle’s University District, with recommendations for Accessible Pedestrian Signals.

members.name: Cannon
members.bio: Cannon designs products from 0 to 1 and builds them, working across design systems, rapid prototypes and MVPs, and front-end code.

links.label: Case study
links.text: [Cheerful AI](#cheerful-ai): UX Engineer who designed the core screens of an agentic influencer marketing platform, from the dashboard to creator search, and implemented them with Claude Code.

members.name: Lavender
members.bio: Lavender designs clear, accessible web experiences and connects them to marketing, content and analytics in GA4 and Tableau.

links.label: Case study
links.text: [UW CoMotion](#uw-comotion): UX Designer on a new program website, a restructured inventorship guide and a resource library prototype, built in Figma and WordPress.
